transcript:
Meeting: Navigator Strategy & Ops Signal
Date: 2026-10-08
Start: 15:00 PDT (22:00 UTC)
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Leah Kim, Marcus Trent, Ravi Patel, Sofia Lopez, Evan Brooks + all-hands

Summary: leadership updates touching product priorities, a recent outage RCA, hiring posture, and operational experiments to reduce token costs without degrading latency. Short Q&A at the end.

---

[00:00] Leah Kim: Hey everyone, thanks for joining on time. Uh, we'll kick off, we've got a pretty tight agenda so I'll keep this short. High level — Q4 focus, reliability learnings, and a couple of operational experiments that Marcus will walk through.

[00:22] Marcus Trent: Cool, thanks Leah. Hi all, Marcus here — quick status on infra. The 09/30 incident was primarily a routing storm that bubbled up to a cascade in the autoscaler, and we saw some KV cache — um k v cash — misses which amplified tail latency. We're shipping two fixes this week: improved prefix caching heuristics and a soft cap on concurrent batching.

[00:45] Speaker 1 (Ravi?): Sorry, just to clarify, when you say soft cap do you mean at the node level or at routing?

[00:52] Marcus Trent: At the worker node level, yes. We also added a fallback policy so requests can be routed to a slightly cheaper model variant if latency budgets are at risk. That ties into cost/latency tradeoffs.

[01:10] Leah Kim: Quick context on product priorities — Ravi?

[01:14] Ravi Patel: Thanks. Q4 we are narrowing into three bets: 1) rollout of streaming + tool-calling improvements to reduce developer integration pain, 2) Optimize for production economics — meaning batching, cache recommendations and smarter defaults in the Console, 3) Dedicated and Private packaging improvements; especially focused on compliance templates. We'll be trimming some lower-impact items to keep the team focused.

[01:50] Audience: applause / murmur

[02:02] Sofia Lopez: On the engineering side, we are reallocating two squads to work on the routing experiment Marcus mentioned. The plan is A/B style — 10% traffic for two weeks, measure p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens. Note: metric collection includes token-level breakdowns but the telemetry team flagged a small gap in route attribution in the Console.

[02:30] Evan Brooks: Hiring update — runway assumptions changed a bit after larger-than-expected usage. We are modeling a few scenarios: aggressive hiring, moderated hiring, and hiring pause. I don't want to call it a freeze yet but I'm asking managers to prioritize critical roles. I'll publish scenarios and a recommended path on Monday.

[03:00] Leah Kim: Super helpful. I want to emphasize transparency — we'll share the numbers. On sales/Dedicated we are seeing enterprise interest but it requires stronger security artifacts; Marcus and Ravi we'll coordinate with Solutions to produce a 'Dedicated readiness' checklist.

[03:25] Marcus Trent: Yeah, Solutions asked for SOC 2 mapping and some of the audit log exposures. We have a stub of that in the security repo but need to make it consumable for non-technical buyers.

[03:40] Ravi Patel: Also, small product note — we're testing a new default quantization profile that lowers memory pressure on 80B models; should be opt-in for now, and we'll surface perf/cost deltas in the model card.

[04:00] Speaker 2: There was a question earlier — is this going to change existing customer SLAs?

[04:05] Leah Kim: No SLA changes planned. For customers on Dedicated with contracts we will maintain current commitments. Any routing experiment will start internal and in staging, then with opt-in customers.

[04:20] Speaker 3 (Engineering Lead): On the incident RCA, can we get the timeline published? The oncall wants the exact sequence to work on playbooks.

[04:27] Sofia Lopez: Yes — we'll publish a timeline and a brief checklist. It's in draft now. Follow-up session scheduled, invite after this call.

[04:45] Leah Kim: Ok, quick round-robin — three things each of you should take away. Marcus?

[04:50] Marcus Trent: Ship the caching heuristic and the soft cap patch to prod canary, monitor p99 and p95. Also start the routing experiment on staging.

[05:05] Ravi Patel: I'll finalize Q4 priorities doc with design tradeoffs, share by Monday.

[05:12] Sofia Lopez: Publish the RCA timeline and run the follow-up with oncall + SRE.

[05:20] Evan Brooks: Publish hiring scenarios and recommended path for leadership review.

[05:28] Leah Kim: Great. Open Q&A — please be concise.

[05:35] Speaker 4 (PM): How are we communicating the Dedicated pricing changes to partners? Any risk?

[05:40] Leah Kim: We're coordinating with GTM this week. Price memos will go to account teams; Solutions will have a one-pager. No public announcement yet.

[05:50] Speaker 5 (Engineer): On the routing experiment — do we risk model hallucination differences if we route to cheaper variants?

[05:58] Ravi Patel: Good point. We'll include a quality gate — regression tests against a prompt set. If any regression beyond threshold, that route will be disabled.

[06:12] Speaker 6 (New Hire, muted at first): I have a question about growth — are we reallocating headcount from product to infra?

[06:18] Evan Brooks: We're not slicing headcount today; it's more about temporary reallocation of sprints. The hiring scenarios will reflect any longer-term moves.

[06:30] Speaker 7 (Sales lead): Do we have a timeline for the SOC2 artifacts? Customers are asking now.

[06:38] Marcus Trent: We have a mapping and expect a consumable package within three weeks, but I'll confirm deadlines with Remi in Security.

[06:50] Leah Kim: Thanks. Two housekeeping items: update your team pages and add to the incident page with lessons learned. Also, we are piloting a weekly 30-minute cross-functional sync on Thursdays for the next six weeks to tighten rollout coordination.

[07:05] Audience: ack / notes

[07:10] Leah Kim: Ok last slide — culture minute. Kudos to the Observability team for shipping the token-level trace last sprint. Big win.

[07:20] Speaker 8 (Someone off-mic): shoutout to infra too

[07:25] Leah Kim: Alright that's it. We'll post slides and the Q4 doc. Thanks everyone.

[07:30] --- End of live recording; Q&A continued in chat ---
